Legal.termsIntro: These Terms & Conditions govern the use of iDesignStudio.ro and the purchase of products offered through it. By placing an order, you confirm that you have read and accept these terms.
Legal.termsRoleBody: IDESIGN STUDIO S.R.L. acts as the merchant, selling its own event decor and custom stationery products shown on this site directly. The same company is the legal entity that sells the products and issues the invoice for every order.
Legal.termsProductsBody: All prices shown on the site are in RON (Romanian lei). IDESIGN STUDIO S.R.L. is not a VAT payer, so prices do not include VAT. We reserve the right to change prices and product availability without prior notice; such changes do not affect already-confirmed orders.
Legal.termsPaymentBody: Online card payments (Visa, Mastercard) are securely processed by NETOPIA Payments, an authorized payment processor. Your card details are never stored on our servers.
Legal.termsDeliveryBody: Personalized products (invitations, stationery, 3D-printed decor) are made to order. The estimated delivery time is made up of processing/production time of 1-2 business days, plus courier transit time. We currently ship within Romania only, via courier, with an estimated delivery time of 1-2 business days after dispatch. Shipping is a flat fee of 20 RON, which includes protective packaging for fragile items, and is free for orders over 250 RON. You'll receive a tracking number (AWB) as soon as your order ships.
Legal.termsReturnsBody: Personalized products (invitations, decor, or stationery made to your specifications — names, text, dates) cannot be returned or exchanged for reasons of personal preference once production has begun, per art. 16(c) of OUG no. 34/2014. You can cancel or modify a personalized order free of charge within 24 hours of placing it, or before production begins, whichever comes first — please contact us as soon as possible. Non-personalized products can be returned within 14 days of delivery, per the "Right of withdrawal" section below. Regardless of product type, if you receive a product that was damaged in transit, defective, or different from what you ordered, please contact us within 48 hours of delivery with photos of the issue — we will offer a replacement or a full refund at no extra cost. Approved refunds are processed to the original payment method used for the order, within 14 days of the return being confirmed.
Legal.termsWithdrawalBody: Under Romanian and EU consumer protection law (OUG no. 34/2014), you have the right to withdraw from a distance contract, without penalty and without giving a reason, within 14 calendar days of receiving the products. To exercise this right, please contact us at the email address below, stating your order number and the products concerned. Products personalized to your specifications are exempt from the right of withdrawal, per art. 16(c) of OUG no. 34/2014.

Legal.privacyIntro: This policy explains what personal data we collect through iDesignStudio.ro, how we use it, and your rights under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
Legal.privacyControllerBody: The controller of your personal data is:
Legal.privacyDataBody: We collect the data you give us directly: name, email address, and password (encrypted) when creating an account, as well as the data needed to process an order (products, amount, shipping address, when you place an order).
Legal.privacyUseBody: We use this data solely to manage your account, process orders, communicate with you about your orders (confirmations, notifications), and to respond to your requests when applicable.
Legal.privacyRightsBody: Under GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, and port your data, as well as the right to object to its processing. To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at the address below.
